question: Do a frozen skill packet, retrieved prior work, or tool feedback alter valid useful work under the same task and resource budget?
already_tested: Deterministic selection package on one exposed P-256 target; one historical manually designed P-521 history-order comparison. These are not this agent experiment.
tool_feedback: Keep exactly the same allowed feedback in every phase1 cell. The final hidden evaluator is identical and is never exposed.
phase2_separate_factor: Only after phase1, preregister tool-feedback supplied/withheld with final evaluation unchanged; do not confound this with persona changes.
small_pilot: Two independent tasks × six phase1 cells × two paired rollout seeds =24 bounded trajectories; descriptive pilot, not a powered confirmation.

task_split.existing_six_curve_targets: Exposed validation corpus, not fresh held-out targets
task_split.needed_confirmation_tasks: Independent owner freezes genuinely unseen target/region outcomes and retains the outcome key outside candidate and prompt-designer access

freeze_before_execution: skill bytes and exact behavior mandates
independent blinded rubric and canonical DAG equality rule
analysis: Report raw task-level paired outcomes. Tasks, not many seeds on one target, are the principal independent units. Keep memory influence on planning separate from improvement in yield.
remaining_admissions: fresh held-out task owner and sealed outcome boundary
same qualified model/tool route across cells
current_resource_authority: No new model/provider work was launched by this support lane. Numeric model-token budgets remain unassigned rather than guessed.
claim_ceiling: A pilot may identify component-specific behavior in the tested setting. It will not qualify unattended Apex, broad memory learning or global optimality.
